hook: You miss the 9pm call. Watch who answers it instead.
caption: After-hours calls are where plumbing jobs quietly slip to a competitor. An AI receptionist answers, sorts emergencies from routine work, and logs every caller in your CRM. You keep working, and nobody waits for a callback.
caption_full:
Plumbers: here's what happens to the 9pm call you can't pick up.

Two rings. The AI receptionist answers, asks if it's an emergency, then grabs the address and a callback number. Burst pipe? Your on-call tech gets a text right away. Dripping tap? Booked for 8am. Every call lands in your CRM with a short summary, so nobody's left waiting on a callback and you don't have to stop mid-job.

Comment CALLS and I'll send you the full workflow.
